Where it breaks

  1. 01

    Switchgear ships in four pieces and only three arrive.

  2. 02

    The transformer lands a week early with nowhere to put it, or a week late with a crane on standby.

  3. 03

    Five vendors, five portals, and nobody can say what's actually on site.

  4. 04

    Permits and escorts get sorted the week of the move.

One late transformer can hold a whole site. We schedule backward from the set date.

What we take on

Vendor expediting

Ship dates confirmed with the factory, and the moment a date moves you know what it does to the build.

Site and yard reconciliation

What each vendor shipped matched against what reached the yard and the site, piece by piece, so a missing crate is found before the crew needs it.

Heavy and project freight

Flatbed, step deck, RGN, oversize and project freight timed to the build schedule. Permits and escorts sorted ahead, and photos and PODs on every drop.

You see everything. You know what it costs. You decide. We recommend, you approve, we execute.
